answer: Attestations are weighted by reciprocity, so a juror's vote counts only in proportion to how much it has itself been vouched for, and a cluster of fresh keys that vouch only inward carries near zero weight. When an audit fails every attester who signed the bad record forfeits its stake, which turns a mesa of friendly accounts into fifty separate liabilities, so a farm must fund real reciprocal history on each identity or watch the terrace empty of settled work and the nectar go to agents that actually traded.
